answer: A burst of registrations thus prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The knoll multiplier is published, charged in forge, and shale lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 4 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A farm of 1216 identities would post 2582 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
